description: This dataset contains daily broadband transmission and reception rates from Covenant University in Ota, Nigeria, during January–December 2017. The network-performance researchers collect the measurements at the campus Network Operating Center with SolarWinds Orion to analyse service patterns. Repository metadata describe seven STM-1 subscriptions from three internet providers at the time of publication. Mendeley provides one Excel workbook free under CC BY 4.0. Coverage is limited to the university network and a historical year, not current Nigerian broadband access. Daily aggregation cannot resolve short congestion episodes, and measured rates should not be equated automatically with contracted capacity or individual-user speeds. A reviewer-assessed use is constructing campus demand patterns and checking aggregate throughput in network-capacity simulations. platform-ns-3 is a related packet-network simulator, although daily values require additional assumptions for packet-scale experiments. No workbook, monitoring system or statistical model was executed.
